absences.reason: No trained CV model and no labelled mask/trace dataset exist in this environment — image-derived measurement is explicitly not claimed.
No model in the registry emits calibrated prediction intervals; FLEX reports a bootstrap AUC CI only. PICP is therefore not computable and not reported.
No embedding credentials or dense index is configured — BM25 lexical retrieval only, labelled as such in the AI-role panel.
No CFD/fire solver runs in this platform; equation calculators are unit-verified with reference tests instead (54/54 recorded).
